chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a slim young Moroccan university student, short curly black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a white drawstring and dark blue jeans
chars.ROOMMATE: ROOMMATE: a broad-shouldered young Moroccan man, buzz-cut black hair, thick dark eyebrows, short black beard, wearing a dark green tracksuit jacket with two white stripes on the sleeves and black tracksuit trousers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening, inside a small simple shared student apartment in a Moroccan city. NARRATOR has just come in through the front door holding his backpack, smiling awkwardly and saying hello. ROOMMATE sits on a sofa with his back half turned, arms crossed, coldly ignoring him, staring at his phone. Tense silence.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, small student kitchen-living room with a warm lamp. NARRATOR sits alone at a small table eating a plate of food, glancing uneasily across the room. In the background ROOMMATE sits silently on his bed in the half-dark, elbows on knees, staring at NARRATOR with a dark brooding expression.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Middle of the night in a dark small bedroom lit only by blue moonlight from a window. NARRATOR, lying in bed under a blanket, suddenly wakes up and lifts his head, worried, looking toward the bedroom door which is slowly opening a crack.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Pitch dark bedroom at night. In the doorway only the dark silhouette of ROOMMATE is visible, standing perfectly still, his eyes catching a faint gleam of moonlight, staring straight toward the bed. Creepy, suspenseful atmosphere, thriller mood, no gore.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Dark bedroom at night, blue moonlight. ROOMMATE kneels on the edge of the bed leaning over NARRATOR, pinning him down by the shoulders, face full of rage. NARRATOR lies on his back in bed, eyes wide in panic, struggling and gasping for air. Dramatic thriller scene, no blood, no gore.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close-up at night in a dark bedroom: ROOMMATE's face half lit by blue moonlight coming from the window, jaw clenched, teeth gritted, wild furious eyes looking down. Thriller atmosphere, no gore.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Dark bedroom at night, blue moonlight. Close view of NARRATOR lying in bed, terrified, eyes wide open, mouth open gasping for breath, hands gripping the blanket. Suspenseful, no gore.
